description: Welcome to the Microsoft Ads MacOS SDK! This software development kit provides you with the necessary tools and libraries to monetize your MacOS apps.
releaseNotes: 9736030: Enhanced Native Ads tracking: Introduced support for third-party OMID trackers and OpenRTB event tracking for `event:555, method:2`. 8869891: Refactored Video Ads implementation and transitioned to using `webview-ads-app`.
title: Microsoft Ads MacOS Software Development Kit
